concerns.text: FR-007 requires the permutation to shuffle patient identifiers while preserving within-patient time ordering of the MDS-UPDRS scores. T006 instead 'shuffles taxon abundance vectors across patients (block-wise permutation preserving each patient's internal time ordering)'. These are different null hypotheses; the task as written will not satisfy FR-007. Align T006 with the spec's permutation scheme or amend FR-007 first.

T003 restricts the slope correlation to patients with ≥3 visits ('Patients with exactly 2 visits are retained for LME but excluded from the slope correlation'). The spec's FR-002/FR-004 and edge cases only exclude single-visit patients; the ≥3-visit narrowing is not authorized anywhere in spec.md. This is a silent retroactive narrowing of FR-004 — record the staging in the spec or remove the restriction.

T001 says 'if none [motor-outcome column], abort early per plan edge-case handling', but FR-004 explicitly requires the pipeline to 'skip the correlation step and log a warning' when no longitudinal clinical severity measure is present. The task contradicts the spec's graceful-degradation requirement.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001, T003, T005 vs spec.md:FR-004, FR-005
concerns.text: FR-004/FR-005 mandate the MDS-UPDRS total score as the outcome ('longitudinal MDS-UPDRS total score'; formula 'MDS_UPDRS_Total ~ ...'). T001/T003/T005 accept 'UPDRS_partIII or MDS_UPDRS_total, whichever column is present', changing the modeled clinical construct without spec authorization. Either amend the spec or restrict tasks to MDS_UPDRS_total.

T009 requires permutation empirical p-values to be 'directionally consistent with LME p-values for the top taxa' — an outcome-dependent scientific claim not required by any SC, and one a correct implementation can fail (especially given the FR-007 permutation-design mismatch). Reword to a validity-only check (range, count, reproducibility).

Result paths diverge across artifacts: spec/data-model say 'results/…' (data-model: 'results/taxa_correlations.csv'), tasks write 'data/results/…'. Pick one canonical path so FR-008 deliverable checks and contract tests don't diverge.
